_comment: Input for scripts/build-payload.mjs, which generates manifest.json, payload/ and originals/ from the project's build output. Paths in 'from'/'originalFrom' are relative to the ui/ folder.
name: MiddleEarth MOD
description: Yenyang's six Middle-earth mods merged into one multiplayer-ready pack (DLC build attached to the free 'Upgrade 1' package). Every player must use the same build.

build._comment: Development only (the app running from this repository): run before every install of this mod, so the app installs the working tree as it is now, committed or not. cwd is relative to ui/. Then the app regenerates this mod's payload. Packaged apps never build. (The capital landmarks ship prebuilt from vendor/landmarks/, so no Blender step is needed: docs/LANDMARKS.md.)
